global_closure_impossibility.description: Analysis of formal impossibility for global closure claims within the Mono-Process Framework.

targets.name: global_reconstruction_closure
targets.basis: Aggregate transport and low-dimensional projection result in irreversible information loss; unique global preimage recovery is formally impossible.

targets.name: exact_epsilon-null_closure
targets.basis: Stability at exact zero is a singular limit where continuation is undefined; exact global closure at this boundary is inaccessible.

targets.name: infinite_recursive_stabilization
targets.basis: Proof of stability for all finite N does not imply stability for N->infinity without unproven asymptotic axioms.

targets.name: unique_continuation_selection
targets.basis: Symmetry-preserving branching is a core dynamic; unique global selection is formally excluded to maintain process symmetry.

targets.name: global_transport_closure
targets.basis: Locally admissible but globally unfinished; non-invertibility may permanently block global causality chains.

targets.name: physics-level_closure_claims
targets.basis: Claims of physical truth or experimental proof are outside the scope of this formal mathematical logic system.
